references.title: Kitchen light
references.notes: Steam catches the window light. Keep the background dark so it reads.

references.title: Coffee, knitted sleeves
references.notes: Soft, even window light with almost no shadow. Warm against cool wool.

references.title: Writing at the desk
references.notes: Side light from a window rakes across the page and the hands.

references.title: At the keyboard
references.notes: Shallow depth of field. The window behind the desk lifts the whole scene.

references.title: Backlit at golden hour
references.notes: Rim light on the hair. Expose for the highlights and let the face fall soft.

references.title: Harbour lights, evening
references.notes: Warm evening light and out-of-focus lamps behind the subject.

references.title: Studio sitting no. 4
references.notes: Low key. The shoulders carry the frame; the face is left in shadow.

references.title: Concrete apex, noon
references.notes: One vanishing point. Hard noon light keeps the grid crisp.

references.title: Doorway, late light
references.notes: Late light warms the stone. Centre the door and keep the verticals straight.

references.title: Facade, midday
references.notes: Fire escapes as rhythm. Midday light flattens the facade into pattern.

references.title: Skyline, blue hour
references.notes: Blue hour haze. Muted palette, almost monochrome.

references.title: City from above, dusk
references.notes: High vantage point at dusk. The lake edge gives the frame a horizon.

references.title: Crossing, from above
references.notes: Straight down onto the crossing. Cars become graphic shapes.

references.title: Harbour haze
references.notes: Flat water and haze. Almost nothing in the frame, and that is the point.

references.title: Deer in morning fog
references.notes: Fog and low sun turn the deer into a silhouette.

references.title: Burnt forest, storm light
references.notes: Bare trunks against a moving sky. Wait for the light to break.
